note: CodeQL results reviewed and accepted, by rule and file (Sagentix, 2026-10-17). The collector-security gate fails on every other result. Add an entry only with a reason a reviewer can check against the code.

accepted.reason: tokenRequest posts a client secret or a signed assertion built from the customer's key file to the identity provider's token endpoint; that exchange is the OAuth grant itself. It refuses plain HTTP, and the Google source accepts a key file's token_uri only on googleapis.com (isGoogleTokenUri).

realWebClient().tls opens a handshake with rejectUnauthorized: false only to read the certificate and judge it: certificate_valid reads socket.authorized and authorizationError (chain and host name) and fails when either is wrong. Nothing is sent on that socket; it is closed right after secureConnect. Every HTTP request of the source goes through fetch with normal verification.
